# TLS Exclusion List for Vim iOS Port
# ====================================
# Variables and files listed here will NOT get __thread added.
# These are either immutable lookup tables, platform-specific files
# that don't run on iOS, or intentionally shared state.
#
# Syntax:
#   file:<filename>         - skip entire file
#   pattern:<regex>         - skip lines matching regex
#   <variable_name>         - skip variable by name (* = wildcard)

# --- Files that don't run on iOS ---
file:dosinst.c
file:uninstall.c
file:os_w32exe.c
file:os_win32.c
file:os_mswin.c
file:os_amiga.c
file:os_vms.c
file:os_qnx.c
file:gui_w32.c
file:gui_dwrite.cpp
file:gui_gtk.c
file:gui_gtk_x11.c
file:gui_gtk_f.c
file:gui_motif.c
file:gui_athena.c
file:gui_photon.c
file:gui_x11.c
file:gui_xim.c
file:gui_xmebw.c
file:gui_beval.c
file:gui_haiku.cc
file:gui.c
file:os_macosx.m
file:beval.c
file:if_cscope.c
file:if_xcmdsrv.c
file:if_py_both.h
file:netbeans.c
file:pty.c
file:sound.c
file:wayland.c
file:wayland.h
file:gui_xmdlg.c
file:gui_x11_pm.h
file:iscygpty.c
file:dosinst.h
file:if_lua.c
file:if_mzsch.c
file:if_perl.xs
file:if_python.c
file:if_python3.c
file:if_ruby.c
file:if_tcl.c
file:xdiff/xdiffi.c
file:xdiff/xemit.c
file:xdiff/xhistogram.c
file:xdiff/xmerge.c
file:xdiff/xpatience.c
file:xdiff/xprepare.c
file:xdiff/xutils.c
file:libvterm/src/state.c
file:libvterm/src/pen.c
file:libvterm/src/parser.c
file:libvterm/src/unicode.c
file:libvterm/src/vterm.c
file:libvterm/src/keyboard.c
file:libvterm/src/mouse.c
file:libvterm/src/screen.c

# --- Immutable constant lookup tables ---
# These are effectively const data, safe to share across threads.

# autocmd.c: event name lookup table
pattern:keyvalue_T\s+event_tab\b
# blowfish.c: crypto constants
pattern:UINT32_T\s+pax_init\b
pattern:UINT32_T\s+sbx_init\b
pattern:struct_bf_test_data\s+bf_test_data\b
# charset.c: Latin-1 character classification tables
pattern:char_u\s+latin1flags\b
pattern:char_u\s+latin1upper\b
pattern:char_u\s+latin1lower\b
# clipboard.c: const data
pattern:supported_mimes\b
pattern:vwl_data_offer_listener\b
pattern:vwl_data_device_listener\b
pattern:vwl_data_source_listener\b
# crypt.c: method table and magic
pattern:cryptmethod_T\s+cryptmethods\b
pattern:crypt_magic_head\b
# digraph.c: digraph table (huge, const data)
pattern:digr_T\s+digraphdefault\b
# evalfunc.c: argument type check tables (150+ entries, all const)
pattern:argcheck_T\s+arg\d
pattern:argcheck_T\s+arg_\w
# evalfunc.c: global function table
pattern:funcentry_T\s+global_functions\b
# ex_cmds.h: command table
pattern:excmd_T\s+excmd_table\b
# ex_docmd.c: command modifier info
pattern:cmdmod_info_T\s+cmdmod_info_tab\b
# highlight.c: highlight/color tables
pattern:highlight_init_both\b
pattern:highlight_init_light\b
pattern:highlight_init_dark\b
pattern:keyvalue_T\s+highlight_tab\b
pattern:keyvalue_T\s+highlight_index_tab\b
# map.c
pattern:modmasktable\b
pattern:key_names_table\b
# mbyte.c: Unicode tables
pattern:langstrstringsstrmap\b
pattern:langstringsstrmap\b
# message.c: langstrmap
pattern:langstrmap\b
# option.c: options table
pattern:vimoption_T\s+options\[\]
# syntax.c
pattern:keyvalue_T\s+hl_grouptab\b
# regexp.c / regexp_nfa.c
pattern:char_u\s+e_missingbracket\b
pattern:char_u\s+e_unmatchedpp\b
pattern:char_u\s+e_unmatchedp\b
pattern:char_u\s+e_z_not_allowed\b
pattern:char_u\s+e_missing_sb\b
pattern:char_u\s+e_empty_sb\b
# term.c: builtin terminal entries, color lookup tables
pattern:builtin_terminals\b
pattern:tcap_entry_T\s+builtin_\w+\b
pattern:langstringsstrmap\b
# textformat.c, textobject.c: const message strings
pattern:N_\(
# popupmenu.c
pattern:pum_rl_type_list\b
# userfunc.c
pattern:lambda_name\b

# --- Constant string arrays (N_ macro = gettext, immutable) ---
# main.c: usage strings
pattern:char\s+\*\(use\[\]\)
# main.c: error messages (already has __thread, but adding for safety)
pattern:char\s+\*\(main_errors\[\]\)
# cmdhist.c: history type names
pattern:history_names\b

# --- hardcopy.c: PostScript constant data tables ---
pattern:struct prt_ps_font_S\s+prt_ps_courier_font\b
pattern:struct prt_ps_font_S\s+prt_ps_mb_font\b
pattern:struct prt_ps_encoding_S\s+\w+_encodings\b
pattern:struct prt_ps_charset_S\s+\w+_charsets\b
pattern:struct prt_ps_mbfont_S\s+prt_ps_mbfonts\b

# --- Shared state (intentionally not per-thread) ---
# Instance tracking
vim_active_instances

# --- Large string constant arrays (N_ macro = gettext, immutable) ---
pattern:char\s+\*msg_loclist\b
pattern:char\s+\*msg_qflist\b

# --- Struct-typed constant tables ---
pattern:rgb_name_table_T\s+rgb_tab\b
pattern:nv_cmd_T\s+nv_cmds\b
pattern:spec_table_T\s+spec_str_tab\b

# --- evalfunc.c: type constants ---
pattern:type_T\s+t_\w+
